effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Gammamon] in its text from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
